_meta.not_computable_rule: 2026-11-11: a required window is classed not computable (key soft_face_locking, compatibility name) only when the stick-memory window AND the production-law restart of the same checkpoint both stopped before an evaluation point; the first-increment pattern alone is noted (first_increment_pattern) and no longer vetoes a fallback; designs built from identical decks list each other under replicates
_meta.set_precedence: per window the highest-ranked set in SETS wins: physio_fric5 (stick-memory law, PI 2026-11-09) supersedes physio_fric3 (production law, NUM-13 artefact); physio_relG (process G, PI 2026-11-10 option a) holds the 27 insertion-stopped designs; physio_relG_pl is a fallback source only (production law on the G checkpoint, + margin, flagged); the insertion-stopped scans: physio_fric3 then physio_relG
_meta.rule: PI 2026-11-10: posterior 0.45-0.55 mm at the evaluation point = grey (analysis only, never a final design), > 0.55 or any-direction > 1 mm = fail; every row/design carries insertion_process and window_law (PI 2026-11-10 option a); PI 2026-11-03 04:30, confirmed 2026-11-05: evaluation point = 1.5 N m state when transmitted, else intact ROM; limits 1 mm any / 0.5 mm posterior; PI 2026-11-07 decision 1: this friction result is a CHECK of the mu_req (tied) slip-out verdict, not a gate (collect_split records friction_check); the 2026-11-03 gate-4 role is withdrawn
_meta.provisional: verdicts provisional: physio_fric3 windows carry the FEBio stick-point artefact (NUM-13); PI 2026-11-09 decision 1 recomputes them as physio_fric5 (stick-memory law, same checkpoints) which supersedes fric3 per window here; NUM-17 (0.5 mm grey zone) and the density reference (DECISIONS 2026-11-05 item 8) still open
